specialRules: Dwarfen Scourge: Once per game, when an opposition player is Knocked Down as a result of a Block Action performed by Ivan, you may apply an additional +1 modifier to the Armour Roll or Injury roll. If this is against a Dwarf player this may instead be a +2 modifier.
